releaseNotes: Color by WBS is now a one-click worksheet tool: paste the P6 schedule into Excel, click COLOR BY WBS, and the existing sheet is colored in place - classic P6 level bands (blue root, light green, yellow, ...) across the full schedule width, formulas, dates, values and column order untouched. No XER, no project loading.

WBS to HTML generates the classic planner report directly from the active worksheet: dark slate title strip, sticky table with level-colored WBS bands and ancestor color guides, 30px rows, three-tier timeline, Gantt with baseline and data-date lines, activity/column filters, column picker, expand to level, tab-delimited copy. No XER, no project loading.
Exact 21-level classic P6 palette shared by Excel coloring, the new small WBS Color Settings dialog and the HTML report.

Detection engine shared by both tools: header aliases, WBS vs activity by structure (any activity ID format), hierarchy levels from real indentation evidence - zero reliance on guessing for a normal P6 paste.

Excel proof: the full 123-band / 328-activity reference schedule was colored and read back inside real Excel - every level fill, font color, size, full-row extent, untouched activity rows, and a second click changes nothing.
All release gates re-run: the exact built installer was executed on a fresh machine against an offline update endpoint, and the published bytes were re-downloaded and executed after publishing.
